dataset.note: The v4 source preceded the data-hash pin. Its parser diagnostics match the audited local CSV counts, but v4 itself did not verify or record the CSV SHA-256.

source.model_configuration: Unchanged training/train.py configurations: Extra Trees, Random Forest, scikit-learn MLP, and CUDA PyTorch MLP; seed 23; 300 trees; fixed 45 epochs and batch size 1024 for the CUDA MLP.

timestamp_parser_diagnostics.sampling_assumption: Within each whole-second timestamp bucket, CSV row order is treated as 10 Hz sensor order; sub-second timing cannot be verified.

test_metrics_exploratory_only.interpretation: Animal 1/6 results and candidate families were previously inspected. These are descriptive rerun metrics, not independent validation or acceptance evidence. The CUDA MLP's higher test macro-F1 does not override its lower validation macro-F1; Extra Trees remains the validation-selected model.

cuda_training_steps.inference_basis: The submitted v4 script runs 45 epochs over batches of 1024: ceil(13746/1024)=14 batches per epoch for validation fit, then ceil(14231/1024)=14 batches per epoch for refit. Each CUDA call therefore has 630 AdamW updates. This is inferred from source and row counts, not directly logged in v4.

status_limitations: Holdout animal 6 had already been inspected in earlier versions; all v4 metrics are exploratory and post-exposure.
Validation group animal 1 and the same model families were previously used; no independent acceptance claim is supported.
Very small standing/lying class support makes per-class scores unstable.
The exact input file hash was not embedded by v4; v5 is needed for pinned-data reproducibility and direct optimizer-step logging.
artifact_policy: Raw dataset, full evaluation with detailed reports, kernel log, and joblib checkpoint remain private in Kaggle; this repository stores aggregate metrics and hashes only.
